# SkillDARA

> SkillDARA (https://www.skilldara.com) is a platform of eight AI agents for students and professionals to upgrade their skills and get job-ready. It is built by DigiDARA Technologies. Start free with 25 coins.

## What it offers
- [Coding Practice](https://www.skilldara.com/agents/coding-practice/): Practise coding with real test cases and an AI tutor.
- [Aptitude Trainer](https://www.skilldara.com/agents/aptitude-trainer/): Quantitative, logical and verbal practice with explanations.
- [Communication Coach](https://www.skilldara.com/agents/communication-coach/): Speaking, pronunciation and writing practice scored by AI.
- [Mock Interview Agent](https://www.skilldara.com/agents/mock-interview/): Technical and HR mock interviews with feedback on every answer.
- [Resume Builder](https://www.skilldara.com/agents/resume-builder/): Build an ATS-friendly resume in a guided workflow.
- [Job Agent](https://www.skilldara.com/agents/job-agent/): Find jobs that match your profile, ranked by fit.
- [Capstone Project Agent](https://www.skilldara.com/agents/capstone-project/): Take a project from topic to graded submission.
- [AI Certification Agent](https://www.skilldara.com/agents/ai-certification/): Chat-based assessments and downloadable certificates.
- One account for all agents, with chat history across devices.
- For colleges: an organization dashboard, class and staff management, proctored assessments and reports.

## Audience
Students preparing for placements, fresh graduates, job seekers and working professionals. Colleges and training institutes as organizations.

## Pricing
Free to start (25 coins). One-time coin packs: Basic Rs 399 (250 coins), Standard Rs 799 (500 coins), Premium Rs 999 (750 coins). Coins never expire. Prices are before GST.
